title: What does Modern Maison offer?
answer: Modern Maison Co offers catering, charcuterie classes, kids’ cooking sessions, boards and grazing options.

title: Current classes and workshops
answer: We offer a variety of classes and workshops on a quarterly basis. Current offerings vary and can be found on our Current Classes page. Our class categories include Charcuterie Workshops, Kids’ Cooking Classes, and Senior Classes. We offer a fully mobile characuterie workshop/classes, meaning we bring the entire expeirence to your home/airbnb/location of choice! All supplies are included. For specific class information or to host your own curated class, please visit our charcuterie classes page.

title: Private classes
answer: Yes. We offer private workshops and cooking classes for birthday parties, corporate events, family gatherings, and other special occasions.

title: Catering services
answer: We specialize in catering for all occasions, including intimate gatherings, weddings, corporate events, and celebrations of all sizes. Our menus are tailored to reflect your vision, offering a mix of elegance, flavor, and creativity. We offer a customizable experience for any event, including bespoke experiences designed with you in mind.

title: What is included in the charcuterie workshops?
answer: Our charcuterie workshops include all tools and ingredients needed to create a stunning board, instruction on pairing flavors, arranging designs, and creating an aesthetic spread, and a completed 10x10 in. board to take home and enjoy. For more information on hosting your own group workshop, please visit the charcuterie classes page.

title: Are the kids’ cooking classes age-specific?
answer: Yes. Our kids’ classes are tailored to ages 8-17 to ensure the experience is fun, engaging, and age-appropriate.

title: How do I stay updated on new classes and services?
answer: Follow us on Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/modernmaisonco/), Tiktok (https://www.tiktok.com/@modernmaisoncompany), Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/ModernMaisonCo/)

title: Charcuterie boxes basics
answer: We offer a variety of Charcuterie boxes, ranging from our Individual Charcuterie Boxes ($25) and requiring a minimum order of 10, to other boxes that start at $90, serve 3 to 4 people, and are custom made. Selections vary. Dietary options listed include traditional, vegan, vegetarian, gluten free, pork free, halal, and pescatarian. Orders must be placed 72 hours in advance, and delivery fee may vary based on location.

title: Contact email
answer: You can contact Modern Maison at char@modernmaisonco.com.

title: Delivery radius and fees
answer: We offer delivery within approximately 20 miles of Detroit. Delivery is $30 within this range, with a $200 minimum order required. We may travel up to 30 minutes from Detroit for larger orders or events. For smaller orders, we typically stay within a 20-mile radius. Areas include Detroit, Royal Oak, Warren, Sterling Heights, Ferndale, Troy, Birmingham, Bloomfield, Dearborn, Farmington, Southfield, and more. For exact availability, we recommend confirming with your zip code.

title: How far in advance should I order?
answer: All orders must be placed at least 72 hours in advance. For large catering events, weddings, or custom experiences, we recommend booking even earlier to secure your desired date.

title: Minimum catering order
answer: Our catering services require a minimum of 30 people. This allows us to provide the full Modern Maison experience with proper setup and presentation.

title: General pricing information
answer: Pricing varies based on your event size, customization, and add-ons. For detailed pricing, please visit our website or request a custom quote. We’re happy to tailor options to fit your needs and vision.

title: Wedding and large event add-ons
answer: For weddings and events with 50+ guests, greenery and decorative add-ons are available for a flat rate starting at $75. Smaller events may have greenery priced between $70–$100 depending on the setup.

title: Accepted payment methods
answer: We accept all major payment methods including credit card, Apple Pay, PayPal, and CashApp. Credit card payments include a 3.5% processing fee. For larger catering orders, invoices may be sent directly through our system.

title: Deposit requirements
answer: All large catering orders require a 50% deposit to secure your date. Smaller charcuterie board orders do not require a deposit.

title: Cancellation policy
answer: Cancellations made within 10 days of your event will receive 75% of the deposit back, while 25% is retained as a non-refundable fee. No refunds are available for other completed or fulfilled orders.

title: Allergy and dietary accommodations
answer: We offer a variety of dietary accommodations including vegetarian 🌱, vegan 🥗, gluten-free 🌾❌, pork-free 🐖❌, halal 🕌, and pescatarian 🐟 options. While we do our best to accommodate allergies, we cannot guarantee a completely cross-contamination-free environment.

title: How do I check availability?
answer: To check availability, please provide your desired date, event type, number of guests, and delivery location. Our team will confirm availability as soon as possible.

title: Job opportunities

title: Business hours and response time
answer: Our team responds to inquiries Monday through Saturday from 8 AM to 8 PM (EST). All communication is handled via email, and we aim to respond as quickly as possible during business hours.
